struct.doc: Reset values differ per bank, so the REG line's reset=unknown stands for none of them: bank n resets to n for n = 0 to 7 (established, [spec] table 6-14; no shipped software writes banks 2 to 7). With 32 MiB parts that puts bank n at n * 32 MiB. #define CRIME_MEM_BANK_CONTROL_RESET_BASE 0 /* established: reset of bank 0 #define CRIME_MEM_BANK_CONTROL_RESET_STEP 1 /* established: reset of bank n is BASE + n * STEP
